description: Renders a single-choice list of selectable items. The user picks exactly one item; the chosen item's id and label are posted as the user's next message. Use when the agent asks the user to choose one option from a list.

title.description: Card heading shown at the top.

body.description: Optional supporting text shown under the title. Markdown is NOT rendered.

label.description: Visible item text — also posted as the user's next message when the item is chosen.

description.description: Optional secondary line shown below the label.
